notes.title: Pox Nora Winter 2016 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

We want 2016 to end with a Bang, with a Massive Update and Awesome Deals!

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/WinterSaleLarge2016.jpg[/IMG]

We are happy to say the free Winter Holiday campaign featuring the lovable Krampus is once again available. Along with the Holiday Reskin, Holiday Bundle, and Holiday Extended Set Special packs.

The Holiday Packs and free Winter Holiday campaign are available from December 15th, 2016 to January 5th, 2017.

We appreciate the patience and support of the Pox Nora community. This Massive Update for all of you to play over the winter holidays includes a ton of balance and bug fixes, but more so, it includes a lot of the back-end work we have done in preparation of the new Pox Nora game client. Things are now at the point where we can start bringing the two versions in sync with one another and do this massive update!

[B]General[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Added a new Holiday Bundle pack to the Marketplace. Each pack contains 3 Exotics and 1 Legendary from the Spirits Beyond, Visions of Amareth and Path of De'lim expansions, along with 10 Platinum Tokens and 5000 Shards
[*]The festive Holiday Reskins pack is available again on the Marketplace. Each pack comes with 1 Limited Edition rune from 8 holiday themed reskins of legendary runes and 2 platinum tokens.
[*]The Holiday Extended Set Special pack is now available on the Marketplace. Each of these packs give the following runes from the Extended Set: 1 legendary, 1 exotic, 2 rares, 4 uncommons and 4 commons.
[*]For a limited time the Winter Holiday campaign featuring Krampus will be available to all players for free. Completing this campaign on Legendary difficulty will award 2 Platinum tokens.
[*]Five new Wallpapers have been added to the PoxNora.com.
[/LIST]
[B]Ability Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]High Ground has been consolidated into Hunter: Walker
[*]Hunter: X abilities no longer stack with each other
[*]All of the Jab abilities have been consolidated into being Sabotage abilities with the following format:
[LIST]
[*]The next enemy champion deployed from the runedock while this champion is in play takes 6 <type> damage and gains Vulnerability: <type>.
[/LIST]
[*]The following abilities have been renamed:
[LIST]
[*]Bloodless has been renamed Eternal
[*]Reclaim Relic is now Ruin
[/LIST]
[*]Restless Souls, Voil Caverns, New Growth, Gravebind and Corpse Restoration, etc. now all trigger once per turn only
[*]Sustain has been consolidated into Transfer Life
[*]Swoop has been consolidated with Pounce, retaining the Pounce name but being single target
[LIST]
[*]This champion is relocated to the closest non-damaging space to target enemy unit within 5 spaces and makes a Physical attack at +2 DMG against the target if able.
[*]AP: 4, CD: 2
[*]This means that most Swoop champions are now slightly better, benefiting from the reduced AP cost and CD
[/LIST]
[*]Massive Leap has renamed to Seismic Leap and redesigned to
[LIST]
[*]This champion is relocated to target space within 4 spaces. Enemy champions within 2 spaces of the target takes 10 Physical damage (this damage ignores DEF), are knocked back 1 space and become <condition value=slowed>Slowed</condition> for 2 turns.
[/LIST]
[*]Shatter Summoned is now:
[LIST]
[*]Area Effect 3, Range 5: Enemy illusions and summoned units take 15 Psychic damage.
[*]AP: 3, CD: 3
[*]This allows for greater control over the effect area and increases the AP efficiency of the ability as well as the maximum output of the ability
[/LIST]
[*]A new ability "Blood Spear" has been added:
[LIST]
[*]This champion makes a Loss of Life attack at RNG 2-5. If the target is <condition value=bloodied>Bloodied</condition> or has less than 50% HP remaining , this champion vampiric heals for 8.
[*]Nora: 7, AP: 4, CD: 3
[*]Bloodbinder Count and Demonvein Vampyre have this ability
[/LIST]
[*]A new ability "Vine Whip" has been added to the game!
[LIST]
[*]Description: This champion makes a Physical attack at RNG 2-5. If the target is occupying Vegetation, Ensnared or Rooted and is successfully damaged, the target also becomes Burred for 3 turns and Eviscerated for 3 turns.
[*]Nora: 6, AP: 4, CD: 3
[*]Seed of Potential, Naria Ragevine, Tainted Vinecreeper and Tree Spider have this ability
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]Champion Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Due to the size, the Patch Notes have been modified to not display runes that have only had their cost change due to ability cost changes (rather than an actual change to the rune's kit/design)
[*]Access to Dispel has been greatly reduced in Protectorate factions
[*]A number of lower cost champions lost a drawback ability to decrease efficiency
[*]Distribution of Commander, Defender and Boost have been adjusted. Themes should generally only have access to a single one of these
[*]Distribution of Healing has been changed. Protectorate factions get stronger healing but at higher cost and CD generally, while Wrath factions get weaker healer but at lower cost and CD, as well as "alternate" forms of healing such as Transfer Life more frequently.
[/LIST]
[B]Spells, Relics and Equipment Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Many Spells, Relics and Equipment have had their descriptions cleaned up as part of our ongoing efforts to streamline game text and add condition/ability linking
[*]A number of Spells and Equipment have gotten redesigns
[*]All Warbanners now cost 25 nora
[*]Cleansing Emerald is now ST/KF, with Impairing Sapphire being moved to SP/SL, expect Impairing Sapphire to get a redesign at some point down the line
[*]A number of equipment now gives the actual ability equivalents of their effects, instead of a one-off version. For example, Elsari Shackles granting Careless instead of causing AP loss on its own
[/LIST]
[B]Conditions [B]Changes[/B][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Intoxicated condition no longer debuff enemies. The fact that this was both a debuff and a buff at the same time caused bugs and issues from both a technical and a balance perspective. The "Mead Trap" relic has been redesigned to accommodate the change since it'd no longer work properly.
[*]Illuminated condition no longer gets removed on attack. This means that it no longer generates nora either, but will debuff the enemy's DEF and ability to Stealth for the entire duration. This was done to simplify the condition a bit as it was doing a lot of different things at once, as well as to emphasis it's debuff/anti-stealth side instead.
[/LIST]
[B]Bugs (General)[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue with the Gold bonus timer refunding upon relaunching client on some accounts.
[/LIST]
[B]Bugs (Abilities)[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where Death Harvest was not working at all
[*]Fixed an issue where some abilities were bypassing Buffers:
[LIST]
[*]Hunter: X
[*]Cull
[*]Psychological Warfare
[/LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where Frost Stance was not granting Catalyst: Frost correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Bulwark Jakei that was preventing it from working.
[*]Fixed an where if a player possess a champion with Riftwalker that champion could be sacrificed even if the player is not the owner.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Hunter: Quick was triggering on units with less than 7 SPD.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Impairing Luminescence wouldn't spread to other Nora Gems.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Elusive Leap what was preventing non-basic attacks (such as Constriction).
[*]Fixed an issue where Scouring and Eviscerating Luminescence wouldn't trigger abilities like Hunter.
[*]Fixed an issue where several abilities were not affected by the SL faction bonus or Hunter abilities:
[LIST]
[*]Deafening Aura
[*]Psychic Ping
[*]Rebuke
[*]Flame Siphon
[*]Fry
[*]Wail of Grief
[*]Melt
[*]Shred Defense
[*]Sonic Roar
[*]Magic Beam
[*]Black Tempest
[*]Cannon Barrage
[*]Elemental Storm: Poison
[*]Elemental Storm: Frost
[/LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where if a champion had both Warguard and Combat Awareness 2 they would take 0 damage from spells but still cause Warguard to trigger.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Zeal: Speed wouldn't show a condition when triggered.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Shroud would incorrectly stack.
[*]Fixed an issue where Acolyte abilities sometimes wouldn't trigger from start of turn effects like Auras.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Preparation would lose stacks if the unit has Skirmisher and fails to attack a relic.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Bodyguard would redirected damage incorrectly and be prevented by Combat Awareness by changing Bodyguard to cause Loss of Life instead of damage
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Spell Breach worked on enemies and relics.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Logistics: Force Barrier incorrectly gave Rank 2 instead of Rank 3 of Force Barrier.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Reveal: Kas Pupil could be used more than once if the player had effects that could reduce the CD.
[*]Fixed an issue with the abilities Grant: Teleport and Grant: Reflexes having an incorrect range of 7 when it should have been 5.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Haunting Visions where it was triggering at 30 or less.
[*]Fixed a couple of issue with Mirror Swap. First, it was considering older illusions as closer when they weren't and where it could swap at a longer range than intended.
[*]Fix an interaction issue with the ability Short-Lived that was causing other abilities to not work properly.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Poisonburst ignoring Blinded/Evasive.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Confuse could be used against Impenetrable units.
[*]Fixed an issue where the champion Elven Druid's Bear and Eagle Forms would the champion's range.
[*]Fixed an issue where casting the spell Crescendo on a Shielded unit would still use nora.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Inhibit Power would trigger Snow Blind when centered on a unit.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Wings of Steel's effects could not be removed via Dispel
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Shrine Mulligan not re-reveal Preordained runes.
[*]Fixed an issue with the abilities Shadestrike and Snowstrike that required successful damage instead of successful attack.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Fairy Flight not giving back Flight if unit goes above 15 HP via +MAX HP gains.
[*]Fixed some odd behaviors that could occur if the ability Scrapper was triggered on the opponent's turn.
[*]Fixed an issue where Strike abilities did not work on relics.
[*]Fixed an issue with the abilities Blood Magic and Cannon Barrage where they could be used while pacified.
[*]Fixed an issue where the champion Dwarven Hooligan's ability Attack: Keg wasn't in the first ability slot.
[*]Fixed an issue where some relocation effects were bypassing Wandering and Reckless Flight. In addition, when relocation abilities are used the champion will relocate to an adjacent space if the target space is occupied by a stealthed unit.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Alacrity plays the effect on every single unit, causing significant delay/slowdown
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Arcblade: Frost's second and third attacks were doing Physical damage instead of Frost.
[/LIST]
[B]Bugs (Spells)[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Lost Trails was incorrectly requiring a friendly deployment zone to be targeted.
[*]Fixed an issue with the spell Pilfered Armory not working.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Bullseye's effect would incorrectly lasts 6 turns instead of 1.
[*]Fixed an issue with the spell Ritual of Ashes's Cursed DMG bonus stacking on each champion.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Divinity's Touch no longer worked on champions with the ability Elite.
[*]Fixed an issue where Draconic Pulsar required a target
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Fan Faire did not have a range preview.
[/LIST]
[B][B]Bugs (Relics)[/B][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where the relic The Resistance did not give Slam to newly deployed Elementals.
[*]Fixed an issue where the first Zombie from Corpse Pile incorrectly had upgrades.
[*]Fixed an issue where the relic Lava trap would not spawn stealthed.
[*]Fixed an issue where the buff provide by Collective Struggle was incorrectly removable via Dispel.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Blackguard Banner's effects are incorrectly removable via Dispel.
[/LIST]
[B][B]Bugs (Equipment)[/B][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue with the equipment Chillshard was not properly triggering when new Attacks are gained.
[*]Fixed an issue with the equipment Everfrost Manacles' Frost damage is incorrectly prevented by the SL bonus.
[*]Fixed an issue where Magnetized from the equipment Moga Magnet was pulling units together more than 5 spaces away.
[*]Fixed an issue where the equipment Lightning Rod wouldn't trigger off certain abilities.
[*]Fixed an issue with the spell Stellar Horizon where if it is cast from the runedock, then it comes off CD, and then cast it again, it will heal for more than expected amounts.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Psionic Storm would increases in AE by 1 for every 2 champions instead of for every champion.
[*]Fixed an issue with the equipment Barbed Vine Leash where it would damage champions who Teleports but not champions who Leaps.
[*]Fixed the equipment Avarice to have the proper description. Also resolve issues related to race change effects, and if the equipment was unequipped the DMG debuff was being kept. Now works properly with Goblins.
[/LIST]
[B][B]Bugs (Conditions)[/B][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where the condition Burred was not reduced by the ability Tough

notes.title: Pox Nora Winter 2016 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

We want 2016 to end with a Bang, with a Massive Update and Awesome Deals!

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/WinterSaleLarge2016.jpg[/IMG]

We are happy to say the free Winter Holiday campaign featuring the lovable Krampus is once again available. Along with the Holiday Reskin, Holiday Bundle, and Holiday Extended Set Special packs.

The Holiday Packs and free Winter Holiday campaign are available from December 15th, 2016 to January 5th, 2017.

We appreciate the patience and support of the Pox Nora community. This Massive Update for all of you to play over the winter holidays includes a ton of balance and bug fixes, but more so, it includes a lot of the back-end work we have done in preparation of the new Pox Nora game client. Things are now at the point where we can start bringing the two versions in sync with one another and do this massive update!

[B]General[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Added a new Holiday Bundle pack to the Marketplace. Each pack contains 3 Exotics and 1 Legendary from the Spirits Beyond, Visions of Amareth and Path of De'lim expansions, along with 10 Platinum Tokens and 5000 Shards
[*]The festive Holiday Reskins pack is available again on the Marketplace. Each pack comes with 1 Limited Edition rune from 8 holiday themed reskins of legendary runes and 2 platinum tokens.
[*]The Holiday Extended Set Special pack is now available on the Marketplace. Each of these packs give the following runes from the Extended Set: 1 legendary, 1 exotic, 2 rares, 4 uncommons and 4 commons.
[*]For a limited time the Winter Holiday campaign featuring Krampus will be available to all players for free. Completing this campaign on Legendary difficulty will award 2 Platinum tokens.
[*]Five new Wallpapers have been added to the PoxNora.com.
[/LIST]
[B]Ability Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]High Ground has been consolidated into Hunter: Walker
[*]Hunter: X abilities no longer stack with each other
[*]All of the Jab abilities have been consolidated into being Sabotage abilities with the following format:
[LIST]
[*]The next enemy champion deployed from the runedock while this champion is in play takes 6 <type> damage and gains Vulnerability: <type>.
[/LIST]
[*]The following abilities have been renamed:
[LIST]
[*]Bloodless has been renamed Eternal
[*]Reclaim Relic is now Ruin
[/LIST]
[*]Restless Souls, Voil Caverns, New Growth, Gravebind and Corpse Restoration, etc. now all trigger once per turn only
[*]Sustain has been consolidated into Transfer Life
[*]Swoop has been consolidated with Pounce, retaining the Pounce name but being single target
[LIST]
[*]This champion is relocated to the closest non-damaging space to target enemy unit within 5 spaces and makes a Physical attack at +2 DMG against the target if able.
[*]AP: 4, CD: 2
[*]This means that most Swoop champions are now slightly better, benefiting from the reduced AP cost and CD
[/LIST]
[*]Massive Leap has renamed to Seismic Leap and redesigned to
[LIST]
[*]This champion is relocated to target space within 4 spaces. Enemy champions within 2 spaces of the target takes 10 Physical damage (this damage ignores DEF), are knocked back 1 space and become <condition value=slowed>Slowed</condition> for 2 turns.
[/LIST]
[*]Shatter Summoned is now:
[LIST]
[*]Area Effect 3, Range 5: Enemy illusions and summoned units take 15 Psychic damage.
[*]AP: 3, CD: 3
[*]This allows for greater control over the effect area and increases the AP efficiency of the ability as well as the maximum output of the ability
[/LIST]
[*]A new ability "Blood Spear" has been added:
[LIST]
[*]This champion makes a Loss of Life attack at RNG 2-5. If the target is <condition value=bloodied>Bloodied</condition> or has less than 50% HP remaining , this champion vampiric heals for 8.
[*]Nora: 7, AP: 4, CD: 3
[*]Bloodbinder Count and Demonvein Vampyre have this ability
[/LIST]
[*]A new ability "Vine Whip" has been added to the game!
[LIST]
[*]Description: This champion makes a Physical attack at RNG 2-5. If the target is occupying Vegetation, Ensnared or Rooted and is successfully damaged, the target also becomes Burred for 3 turns and Eviscerated for 3 turns.
[*]Nora: 6, AP: 4, CD: 3
[*]Seed of Potential, Naria Ragevine, Tainted Vinecreeper and Tree Spider have this ability
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]Champion Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Due to the size, the Patch Notes have been modified to not display runes that have only had their cost change due to ability cost changes (rather than an actual change to the rune's kit/design)
[*]Access to Dispel has been greatly reduced in Protectorate factions
[*]A number of lower cost champions lost a drawback ability to decrease efficiency
[*]Distribution of Commander, Defender and Boost have been adjusted. Themes should generally only have access to a single one of these
[*]Distribution of Healing has been changed. Protectorate factions get stronger healing but at higher cost and CD generally, while Wrath factions get weaker healer but at lower cost and CD, as well as "alternate" forms of healing such as Transfer Life more frequently.
[/LIST]
[B]Spells, Relics and Equipment Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Many Spells, Relics and Equipment have had their descriptions cleaned up as part of our ongoing efforts to streamline game text and add condition/ability linking
[*]A number of Spells and Equipment have gotten redesigns
[*]All Warbanners now cost 25 nora
[*]Cleansing Emerald is now ST/KF, with Impairing Sapphire being moved to SP/SL, expect Impairing Sapphire to get a redesign at some point down the line
[*]A number of equipment now gives the actual ability equivalents of their effects, instead of a one-off version. For example, Elsari Shackles granting Careless instead of causing AP loss on its own
[/LIST]
[B]Conditions [B]Changes[/B][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Intoxicated condition no longer debuff enemies. The fact that this was both a debuff and a buff at the same time caused bugs and issues from both a technical and a balance perspective. The "Mead Trap" relic has been redesigned to accommodate the change since it'd no longer work properly.
[*]Illuminated condition no longer gets removed on attack. This means that it no longer generates nora either, but will debuff the enemy's DEF and ability to Stealth for the entire duration. This was done to simplify the condition a bit as it was doing a lot of different things at once, as well as to emphasis it's debuff/anti-stealth side instead.
[/LIST]
[B]Bugs (General)[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue with the Gold bonus timer refunding upon relaunching client on some accounts.
[/LIST]
[B]Bugs (Abilities)[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where Death Harvest was not working at all
[*]Fixed an issue where some abilities were bypassing Buffers:
[LIST]
[*]Hunter: X
[*]Cull
[*]Psychological Warfare
[/LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where Frost Stance was not granting Catalyst: Frost correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Bulwark Jakei that was preventing it from working.
[*]Fixed an where if a player possess a champion with Riftwalker that champion could be sacrificed even if the player is not the owner.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Hunter: Quick was triggering on units with less than 7 SPD.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Impairing Luminescence wouldn't spread to other Nora Gems.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Elusive Leap what was preventing non-basic attacks (such as Constriction).
[*]Fixed an issue where Scouring and Eviscerating Luminescence wouldn't trigger abilities like Hunter.
[*]Fixed an issue where several abilities were not affected by the SL faction bonus or Hunter abilities:
[LIST]
[*]Deafening Aura
[*]Psychic Ping
[*]Rebuke
[*]Flame Siphon
[*]Fry
[*]Wail of Grief
[*]Melt
[*]Shred Defense
[*]Sonic Roar
[*]Magic Beam
[*]Black Tempest
[*]Cannon Barrage
[*]Elemental Storm: Poison
[*]Elemental Storm: Frost
[/LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where if a champion had both Warguard and Combat Awareness 2 they would take 0 damage from spells but still cause Warguard to trigger.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Zeal: Speed wouldn't show a condition when triggered.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Shroud would incorrectly stack.
[*]Fixed an issue where Acolyte abilities sometimes wouldn't trigger from start of turn effects like Auras.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Preparation would lose stacks if the unit has Skirmisher and fails to attack a relic.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Bodyguard would redirected damage incorrectly and be prevented by Combat Awareness by changing Bodyguard to cause Loss of Life instead of damage
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Spell Breach worked on enemies and relics.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Logistics: Force Barrier incorrectly gave Rank 2 instead of Rank 3 of Force Barrier.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Reveal: Kas Pupil could be used more than once if the player had effects that could reduce the CD.
[*]Fixed an issue with the abilities Grant: Teleport and Grant: Reflexes having an incorrect range of 7 when it should have been 5.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Haunting Visions where it was triggering at 30 or less.
[*]Fixed a couple of issue with Mirror Swap. First, it was considering older illusions as closer when they weren't and where it could swap at a longer range than intended.
[*]Fix an interaction issue with the ability Short-Lived that was causing other abilities to not work properly.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Poisonburst ignoring Blinded/Evasive.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Confuse could be used against Impenetrable units.
[*]Fixed an issue where the champion Elven Druid's Bear and Eagle Forms would the champion's range.
[*]Fixed an issue where casting the spell Crescendo on a Shielded unit would still use nora.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Inhibit Power would trigger Snow Blind when centered on a unit.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Wings of Steel's effects could not be removed via Dispel
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Shrine Mulligan not re-reveal Preordained runes.
[*]Fixed an issue with the abilities Shadestrike and Snowstrike that required successful damage instead of successful attack.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Fairy Flight not giving back Flight if unit goes above 15 HP via +MAX HP gains.
[*]Fixed some odd behaviors that could occur if the ability Scrapper was triggered on the opponent's turn.
[*]Fixed an issue where Strike abilities did not work on relics.
[*]Fixed an issue with the abilities Blood Magic and Cannon Barrage where they could be used while pacified.
[*]Fixed an issue where the champion Dwarven Hooligan's ability Attack: Keg wasn't in the first ability slot.
[*]Fixed an issue where some relocation effects were bypassing Wandering and Reckless Flight. In addition, when relocation abilities are used the champion will relocate to an adjacent space if the target space is occupied by a stealthed unit.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Alacrity plays the effect on every single unit, causing significant delay/slowdown
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Arcblade: Frost's second and third attacks were doing Physical damage instead of Frost.
[/LIST]
[B]Bugs (Spells)[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Lost Trails was incorrectly requiring a friendly deployment zone to be targeted.
[*]Fixed an issue with the spell Pilfered Armory not working.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Bullseye's effect would incorrectly lasts 6 turns instead of 1.
[*]Fixed an issue with the spell Ritual of Ashes's Cursed DMG bonus stacking on each champion.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Divinity's Touch no longer worked on champions with the ability Elite.
[*]Fixed an issue where Draconic Pulsar required a target
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Fan Faire did not have a range preview.
[/LIST]
[B][B]Bugs (Relics)[/B][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where the relic The Resistance did not give Slam to newly deployed Elementals.
[*]Fixed an issue where the first Zombie from Corpse Pile incorrectly had upgrades.
[*]Fixed an issue where the relic Lava trap would not spawn stealthed.
[*]Fixed an issue where the buff provide by Collective Struggle was incorrectly removable via Dispel.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Blackguard Banner's effects are incorrectly removable via Dispel.
[/LIST]
[B][B]Bugs (Equipment)[/B][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue with the equipment Chillshard was not properly triggering when new Attacks are gained.
[*]Fixed an issue with the equipment Everfrost Manacles' Frost damage is incorrectly prevented by the SL bonus.
[*]Fixed an issue where Magnetized from the equipment Moga Magnet was pulling units together more than 5 spaces away.
[*]Fixed an issue where the equipment Lightning Rod wouldn't trigger off certain abilities.
[*]Fixed an issue with the spell Stellar Horizon where if it is cast from the runedock, then it comes off CD, and then cast it again, it will heal for more than expected amounts.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Psionic Storm would increases in AE by 1 for every 2 champions instead of for every champion.
[*]Fixed an issue with the equipment Barbed Vine Leash where it would damage champions who Teleports but not champions who Leaps.
[*]Fixed the equipment Avarice to have the proper description. Also resolve issues related to race change effects, and if the equipment was unequipped the DMG debuff was being kept. Now works properly with Goblins.
[/LIST]
[B][B]Bugs (Conditions)[/B][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where the condition Burred was not reduced by the ability Tough
[*]Fixed an issue with the condition Illuminated not affecting DEF granted by Calcify.
[/LIST]

[/B]

notes.title: Pox Nora at PlayStation Experience Event
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

We are happy to announce the first publicly playable version of [URL=https://www.poxnora.com/index.do]Pox Nora[/URL] for PlayStation® will be at this year’s [URL=http://playstation.com/experience-tickets]PlayStation Experience Event[/URL].

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/PoxPSXLarge.jpg[/IMG]

[B]PlayStation Experience[/B]
Pox Nora for PlayStation will make its first public debut at this year’s PlayStation Experience in Anaheim, California. This will be the first time Pox Nora will be playable on the PlayStation 4. If you want to try out Pox Nora on PlayStation before it is available for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita, this is a must-attend event. PlayStation Experience 2016 will be at the Anaheim Convention Center on December 3rd and 4th, with tickets available for purchase on the [URL=http://playstation.com/experience-tickets]official website[/URL] while supplies last.

[B]Pox Nora for PS4 & PS Vita[/B]
In summer 2016, we announced that Pox Nora would be coming to the PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita, which also means an improved PC & Mac game client will also be coming!

[B]Cross-Platform Play[/B]
PlayStation and PC & Mac players will be able to play with and against each other in cross-platform play. In addition, multiplayer for Pox Nora will not require PlayStation Plus.

[B]Account Cloning[/B]
Existing Pox Nora players will be able to copy their PC or Mac account's inventory over to their PlayStation™Network account. Please note account cloning will only be available for a limited time after the game is released on the PS4 and Vita, and accounts may only be copied once.

The official Pox Nora on PS4 and PS Vita launch date will be announced soon!

Be sure to follow the our forums, [URL=https://www.youtube.com/user/DesertOwlGames]YouTube[/URL], [URL=https://www.facebook.com/PoxNora-190961210965486/]Facebook[/URL], and [URL=https://twitter.com/poxnora]Twitter[/URL] accounts for details about the release date and the upcoming PC & Mac client. See you on the battlefield!

Discussion: [URL]http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/discussion-pox-nora-at-playstation-experience-event.25229/[/URL]

The Pox Nora Team

notes.title: Boon's Eve 2016
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

We are here to warn all of you of a great darkness that is once again looming upon the lands of Poxanthuru. The border between the realms of the living and dead is weakening.  Once again the Blood Owl has escaped it's prison.  Stop this dark force before it can truly disrupt the world of Poxanthuru.

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/boonseve2016.jpg[/IMG]

If you are skilled enough to beat back this dark force the Blood Owl can be bound to you in servitude!

From October 19th to November 2nd the Boon's Eve campaign will be available on the Pox Nora Marketplace. Completing this campaign on Legendary difficulty will result in being rewarded a Limited Edition Blood Owl rune. On November 2nd the campaign will be removed from the Marketplace but anyone who purchased it before then will still be able to play and earn the Limited Edition rune. This Limited Edition rune can not be traded.

Discussion: [URL]http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/discussion-boons-eve-2016.24943/[/URL]

Enjoy!

Once again summer has reached its conclusion and fall is looming.  To celebrate this transition of seasons in the world of Poxathuru it is our pleasure to bring back Poxtoberfest!

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/homepage_poxtoberfest_02.jpg[/IMG]

With this year's Poxtoberfest we are bringing back the Limited Edition Desert Brew and a Poxtoberfest Maiden in the Poxtoberfest Pack. notes.title: Patch Notes: August 4th, 2016
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

Thanks to all of your feedback we have been able to make some balance tweaks and bug fixes that have popped up with the release of the Planar Disturbances expansion.

Also, If you missed the news Pox Nora will be coming to PlayStation 4 and the PlayStation Vita.  Checkout the trailer for details.
https://youtu.be/BWIlewI0Snc
[B]
General Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The ability Scry has been removed from the game, most champions previously with Scry now has Gift of Scrying instead.
[*]The Manual Reveal options has been disabled.
[*]Xulos the Glorious now has his properly glorious flavor text.
[/LIST]
[B]Bugs[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Statue of Xulos and Aspiring Servant now work with the new Xulos.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Dragonflight, Updraft and Blessing of Al'mara were not granting Hunter: Walker.

notes.title: Planar Disturbances Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

Planar Disturbances is here, and with it comes new runes that expand upon the themes of Spirits Beyond and starts establishing some new ones.  Enjoy the all new campaign and be rewarded with Commander Nisk for taking on the challenge of beating it on Legendary difficulty.  If you want an in-depth breakdown for the design decisions of this expansion then be sure to watch the [URL=https://youtu.be/NEohsgD8GCE]Preview Video[/URL].

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/EXP29Launcher_Banner.jpg[/IMG]

[B]General[/B]
[LIST]
[*]49 New runes have been added to Pox Nora. Two of these new runes are Limited Edition.
[*]The League Rewards have been updated to award Planar Disturbances runes.
[*]The all new Madness in the Mountains campaign has been added to Pox Nora, and is available for purchase on the Marketplace. Find out what new threat has been unearthed in the mountains of Valdac. Completing this brand new campaign on Legendary difficulty will award the Commander Nisk limited edition rune!
[*]Planar Disturbances Pack has been added to the Marketplace. This pack comes with: 6 common, 3 uncommon, and 1 rare rune. Each rare slot has a 10% chance of becoming an exotic. Each pack comes with 1 FREE Platinum Token.
[*]Planar Disturbances Box has been added to the Marketplace. This box comes with 10 Planar Disturbances packs. Get 9 packs and the 10th is FREE. The first pack is guaranteed to contain an Exotic and 500 FREE Shards.
[*]Xulos the Glorious Skin Bundle has been added to the Marketplace for a limited time. This bundle contains the Limited Edition Xulos the Glorious, a variant skin for Xulos, Undead Sage with unique art. 1 Random Exotic rune from Planar Disturbances, and 2 Platinum Tokens.
[*]Planar Disturbances MegaBox has been added to the Marketplace for a limited time. This megabox comes with three boxes of Planar Disturbances, an additional 500 Shards along 5 FREE Platinum tokens.
[*]An all new [URL=https://www.poxnora.com/info/story.do?i=37]Planar Disturbances Story[/URL] chapter is now available!
[*]The Spirits Beyond expansion has been added to the Rune Forge.
[*]The Pox Nora Terms & Conditions have been Revised.
[/LIST]
[B]Xulos the Glorious[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Full reskin of Xulos with unique ability effects
[*]Available via the Planar Disturbances Xulos Bundle
[/LIST]
[B]New Ranked Map Rotation[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Axillium
[*]Elemental Plateau
[*]Forsaken Wastes
[*]Forsaken Wastes II
[*]Grove of Ashes
[*]Ironfist Pass
[*]K'thir Forest
[*]Nora Glades
[*]Ruins of Valdac
[*]Shores of Maljara
[*]Snarling Tangle
[*]Underdepths
[/LIST]
[B][B]Rune Reveal Changes[/B][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Shrine Scry has been changed to be a multiple use mulligan.
[LIST]
[*]Description: Obtain a new set of starting runes. This ability is removed after use, if you play a rune, or after the first round.
[*]This has caused some changes to some existing runes/abilities, such as Sibling.
[/LIST]
[*]Rune Reveals now default to 8 for first player and 9 for second player.
[/LIST]
[B]General Mechanic Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fortify has been removed from all Shrines and Avatars.
[*][LIST]
[*]Relics, Shrines, and Avatars no longer have immunity to Poison or Disease.
[/LIST]
All the Chuck abilities can now target relics and should only summon units with no upgrades.
[*]All the Swarm abilities will now summon to the closest available space.  Any champion summoned this way will no longer have any upgrade abilities.

[*]Stitched Remains will now spawn to the closest available space when a champion with Stitched is destroyed.
[*]All the Hunter and Foe abilities and a number of other abilities have been consolidated into just being Hunter abilities.
[*]The Sundered Lands faction bonus has changed.
[LIST]
[*]Description: Champions you control take 1/2 less damage from champions.
[/LIST]
[*]Logistics abilities now trigger on Class in addition to race.
[*]Continued standardization/consolidation of abilities to AE5, to similar CDs for the expected type, etc.
[*]The ability Deception returns!
[LIST]
[*]Description: This unit is relocated to target space within 5 spaces, 3 Illusion copies of this champion are randomly spawned within 5 spaces of its original location.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]Banned Runes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Phoenix Anklet has been re-enabled for ranked play following a bug fix
[*]Darkmarsh Warsong has been re-enabled for ranked play following a redesign
[LIST]
[*]Nora: 25
[*]Description: The next 3 Boghoppers you deploy from the runedock become Stealthed for 6 turns and costs 10 nora less.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]Drums of War and Player Ranks[/B]
All players who played a minimum of 50 ranked matches and their primary faction was the Drums of War Winning Faction, [B]Underdepths[/B], have been awarded 2000 Gold along with 5 Three Day Gold Bonus Tokens.

[B]Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed several issues that would result in error messages in a match.
[*]Fixed an issue with Ruby and Sapphire Catalyst that when these relics should be destroyed they would be also healed and persist.
[*]Fixed an issue were damaging auras were triggering triggering the ability Swarm when Swarm specifically states basic attacks.
[*]Fixed an issue that when Relocate: Relic was used to move a Relic adjacent to an enemy champion with Aggressive, the ability Aggressive would be triggered.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Reflection ability incorrectly reflected Attack: Loss of Life.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Born in Blood would not cause bloodied.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Black Tempest would affect the same champion more than once.
[*]Fixed an issue with the equipment Phoenix Anklet's Short Lived where the champion was not properly being killed by Short-Lived, and fixed a similar issue with the spell Escape Magic.
[*]Fixed an issue with where the ability Split would not spawn on a champion damaging terrain.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Swoop could be used while a champion was Pacified.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Scythe Whirl wouldn't break stealth.
[*]Fixed an issue where the buff from Reclaim Relic would remain if it was used on an enemy relic.
[*]Fixed an issue with the spell Waylay where it would create a real instead of a summoned champion.
[*]Fixed an issue where the effects of Avenging Flame could not be cleansed.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Corpse Restoration where a Shambling Zombie would still be summoned when the unit with the ability died.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Fledgling Mimicry would incorrectly triggers off Relics.
[*]Fixed an issue where the effects of the ability Ritual of Power were not properly ending.
[*]Fixed an issue where the equipment Scorched Earth wouldn't correctly spawn the champion if the equipped champion was destroyed.
[*]Fixed an issue with the relic Flash Bang would not trigger on stealthed or deployed units.
[*]Fixed an issue where the relic Artillery Marker would sometimes bypass abilities and effects that should have prevented the target from being affected.
[*]Fixed an issue where the condition Foul Rite could not be cleansed.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Wind Aura's range preview was not appearing.
[*]Fixed an issue where Desecrated Zone would not apply Elsari Coven's Cursed in some cases
[*]Fixed an issue where the range preview of Call of the Hunter was displaying the old range of Relocate: Ally.
[*]Fixed an issue where Cracked Egg was not properly creating a champion in some instances.
[*]Fixed an issue where Flame and Frost Armor were giving an old implementation of Damage Shield.
[/LIST]
[B]Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*][URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/planar-disturbances-patch-notes.23670/#post-325005][B]Abilities Part 1[/B][/URL]
[*][URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/planar-disturbances-patch-notes.23670/#post-325007][B][B]Abilities Part 2[/B][/B][/URL]
[*][URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/planar-disturbances-patch-notes.23670/#post-325008][B]Forglar Swamp[/B][/URL]
[*][URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/planar-disturbances-patch-notes.23670/#post-325009][B]Forsaken Wastes[/B][/URL]
[*][URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/planar-disturbances-patch-notes.23670/#post-325010][B]Ironfist Stronghold[/B][/URL]
[*][URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/planar-disturbances-patch-notes.23670/#post-325012][B]K'thir Forest[/B][/URL]
[*][URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/planar-disturbances-patch-notes.23670/#post-325013][B]Savage Tundra[/B][/URL]
[*][URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/planar-disturbances-patch-notes.23670/#post-325014][B]Shattered Peaks[/B][/URL]
[*][URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/planar-disturbances-patch-notes.23670/#post-325015][B]Sundered Lands[/B][/URL]
[*][URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/planar-disturbances-patch-notes.23670/#post-325016][B]Underdepths[/B][/URL]
[/LIST]

notes.title: Spirits Beyond Tribute Event and Planar Disturbances Preview
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

This week we are changing things up a little bit with posting the Planar Disturbances illustration preview on a Thursday, but that isn't all.  We are also happy to announce an event for this weekend that starts right now!

[B]Spirits Beyond Tribute Event[/B]
Beginning today June 30th, and lasting until 10AM PDT on the July 5th any player who plays 10 Ranked or wins 10 Single Player matches will earn 1 Spirits Beyond pack. Matches must last a minimum of 10 minutes to count towards this event. For this event players can earn a maximum of 5 packs!  Packs will be rewarded at this event's conclusion in the entitlement section of the Marketplace.

[B]Planar Disturbances Illustration Preview[/B]
This all new Planar Disturbances illustration preview is accompanied by the names and flavor text of the runes featured.  Start piecing together what these runes do and how they play into the greater Pox Nora narrative.

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/EXP29Preview4.jpg[/IMG]

Sunglade Dryad
The Nefari's fires burnt large scars in the forest, but in most places the blackened earth did not last, and vibrant life returned to these newly sunlit glades.

Centaur Commander
"Our informants said the closest enemy squadron was over a days march away, so who the Pox are these?" -- Nefari Commander

Centaur Banner
Fierce, swift, and dedicated to the nora, Centaur remain a bit more leery of crafted magic than do Elves of the Circle.

Keep following our announcements for more details about the Planar Disturbances expansion.

Discussion: [URL]http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/discussion-reward-event-expansion-29-preview.23365/[/URL]

See all of you on the Battlefield!

notes.title: Planar Disturbances Story Preview & News
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

This has been an exciting week. We announced Pox Nora will be coming to the PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita. Not only does this mean you will be able to play Pox Nora on more devices, but existing Steam players will be getting an all new Game Client.  You can find more details on the [URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/pox-nora-on-playstation.23182/]Pox Nora on PlayStation[/URL] post, and on its [URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/discussion-pox-nora-on-playstation.23184/]discussion [/URL]thread.  Also, checkout the announcement trailer and the PlayStation LiveCast Interview with Desert Owl Games' CEO.  

https://youtu.be/wxg4kLSl8jo
https://youtu.be/kL3mDQeRN40
[B]Expansion 29 Preview[/B]

This week's preview is going to be a little different.  Ahead of Planar Disturbances' release we are posting the expansion's story along with today's rune art preview because as you will see the two are very much connected.

[B]The First Disturbance[/B]

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/EXP29Preview3.jpg[/IMG]

Zeventrech lowered himself down the last part of the cliff face, and stood on the thin strip of sandy beach. The ocean reached far to the horizon, sighing along with him. Lenet, his Jakei escort, and Korin had stayed in the outskirts of Ironfist to handle the new Valdeci problem, so Zeventrech was alone. He was used to it.

The great Sea of Separation spread out before him, and Zeventrech was struck with a rare sense of nostalgia, for the land that he knew lay somewhere out there, beyond sight, which had once been half his home. Long dead... long dead. He turned down to the water at his feet. As expected, there was wreckage in the surf. He had heard reports in J’Thir, passed on up from the Forglar coast, concerned, but uncertain, idle reports. Here it was, though, along the Peaks coast as well, were Zeventrech had worried it would be.

With slow, laborious breathes Zeventrech dropped to one knee. He prodded a small piece of metal -- shipping hull of some kind -- with his staff, and then picked it up. It now made sense why the Salaman investigators were confused. If Gekaal had seen it, there was a chance he would have recognized it, but even that was unlikely. The metal shard hummed deeply with nora, but it was an empty hum, like the sound an instrument makes when touched by a buzzing tuning fork. The nora in the wreckage was inherited and accidental.

Zeventrech had never before encountered this kind of resonance. But he had heard of it. This nora pattern also bore a striking similarity to that which had destroyed the old Empire: the nora of the Separation. But what did it mean for these shards to wash up on Pox’s southern shores?

“It couldn’t be another Separation.” Zeventrech muttered. “The traces appeared after the fact. We had no warning.”

Zeventrech was about to look at the fragment itself, when he heard growling off to the left. With some effort, he stood up, and held his staff at the ready. Zeventrech wasn’t eager for a fight at the best of times, but was a willing and able sorcerer when the need arose. Recently, however, with the Arroyo breaking through and this new disturbance in the nora weave, he was leery of casting any magic at all. Had his personal inspection of the shoreline wreckage not demanded speed, he would have even forgone his teleportation spell. This handicap on his mind, Zeventrech squinted along the surf.

A pack of four beasts, wolflike and on all fours, loped along the water’s edge, alternately smelling nora exuding from the detritus, and eating carrion that had washed in. Spotting the cyclops, they eyed him warily. They were obviously hungry. The front two of the pack approached, testing Zeventrech for a flinch, or weakness. He knew this game.

He took a deep breath. Zeventrech grasped his staff at both ends and raised it high over his head. Then he let out a great roar -- a slight risk, that he would attract something worse, but worth the chance. It had the desired effect. Over a dozen feet tall, robe billowing out and staff splitting the sunlight, with his red glowing eye as though bloodshot and backlit, Zeventrech was a fearsome representative of his race. The mongrels, in due form, fled back the direction they had come.

After a few moments, Zeventrech brought his staff back to his side and coughed. The brutish, barbaric nature of his present-day kin disgusted him, but he could ape it well enough when the need arose. Better to let his enemies think he could crush them with a giant stick, than have to walk over and try.

Zeventrech knelt back down to examine the discarded metal. He turned it over twice in his hand, rubbed it between his fingers, and then tossed it aside to examine another piece in like fashion.

“Fishing boat? Seems unlikely.” He mumbled to himself. “Nora like this doesn’t show up on a fishing boat. A trade vessel, perhaps? The Salaman and the Draksar are trading -- maybe something exploded on a ship? But then, there are pieces of two ships here… hrm.”

Zeventrech tossed the fragments away and collapsed into a sitting position. He looked off to the horizon, as though searching for the source.

“Multiple ships … a battle? Did someone renege on the treaty? But we would have heard about it. And the Salaman would have reported something that took out multiple vessels. Hm. So those were Wrath ships out there, Draksar ships almost certainly. In secret. But what those old sons of Valdec would want with this kind of magic on the open ocean I have no id--- “

Zeventrech felt a chill. A deep tingling ran through his skin, something different from the harsh ice of the Tundra, something different from the chilly breeze which wafted off the waves. He was uncertain, but also very, very afraid. Hastily, he pushed himself standing, as though it would help. His breathing had thickened without him noticing.

He steadied himself. Zeventrech had not become agitated in many years, certainly not since Sarinda returned him to life.

Zeventech closed his eye, channeled nora, and teleported away. Speed was paramount. He would need every moment possible if there was to be any chance of preventing the horror to come.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Expansion 29 Second Preview
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

We have a new piece of rune art to preview today for Expansion 29.  Before getting to the rune art, there is another piece of information we want to share with all of you, the expansion's name.  The official name of Pox Nora's 29th expansion is, Planar Disturbances.  Is this foreboding things to come in future expansions or the impact of previous events?  All of you can start speculating as to what this all means as details continue to unfold.

[B]Rune Art Preview[/B]
How are Kings made?  Is it divine right? Being an excellent commander?  Or, are they the shadow puppet of some political bureaucrat?  Behold the Kingmaker!

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/EXP29Preview2.jpg[/IMG]

Ponder about the role the Kingmaker plays within the the lands and if he is a force for good or has some hidden agenda.  Discuss what his ability Gift: Kingmaker might do and how it will turn the tides of battle.

But that isn't all, there are two other runes featured in this illustration.  See if you can pick them out and determine what they will do.

The Spirits Beyond Midterm is here, and with it comes eight new Legendary runes, a Rating reset, and more!

[LIST]

[*]The Spirits Beyond Midterm Bundle has been added to the marketplace, which contains 3 Spirits Beyond midterm Legendary runes along with 5 platinum tokens.

[B]New [B]Legendary [/B]Runes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Arroyo Riftwalker
[*]Frostwing Slayer
[*]Mother of Frond
[*]Myx Incubator
[*]Naria Strangler
[*]Swift Current
[*]Valdaci Shieldwarden
[*]Zombie Rotwrapper
[/LIST]
[B]Mechanic Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Change the Knockback mechanic so if a champion with no AP, when they would be knockbacked into a chasm, they take 5 DMG per Knockback square instead.  It now functions like being knocked into an object.
[/LIST]
[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed various game crashes.
[*]Fixed an issue when the ability Eternal Life triggers where it was giving the champion created the default upgrades instead of selected upgrades.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Dragon Form was not properly granting the ability Flamestrike.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Dispel would work on champions with Impenetrable,
[*]Fixed an exploit that allowed untradeable champions to be traded by using the increase bid option.
[*]Fixed an issue with the condition Locus Swarmed where it would presist if the affected champion was in the AOE when effect ended.
[*]Fixed an issue where the equipment Akakios's Blade is not giving Flamestrike when it is equipped on Draksars.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Stasis would trigger if it was given to an already deployed champion.  It should now trigger only when a champion comes into play.
[*]Runes that were for the use in Single Player campaigns that some players were able to get through exploits can no longer be used in Ranked Play. 
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Still Life's stealthed condition would go into negative numbers and would not properly refresh when the champion did not move.
[*]Fixed an issue when Damage Over Time Immunity abilities when triggered would create a new ability.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Avatar was not preventing them from being targeted by the Bloodseeker ability.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Preparation were it was only resetting when the attack is successful.

notes.title: Pox Nora Patch Notes: April 7th, 2016
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

We have a patch for all of you to address some of the feedback and observations that have come up since the release of Spirits Beyond.

[B]Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed several issues that would result in error messages in a match.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Flying description on abilities that give this effect was out of date.
[*]Fixed a typo in the Visions of Amareth story.
[*]The status effects for Enraged will now properly show the amount damage was increased.
[*]Fixed an issue where the equipment Special Prize would not give the condition Defenseless after 4 attacks and would sometimes duplicate the equipment to a friendly champion.
[*]Fixed an issue where the spell Forced Reconstruction would not deploy the Misshapen Boghopper on lava.
[*]Fixed an issue on the website where sometimes a players name would appear twice in Search for Player.
[*]Fixed an issue on the website where not all of the non-standard leagues were being shown on the rankings pages.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Irresponsible Essence Imbibment was not causing the champion to gain HP.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ability Mind Lock where if the target had no non-basic attack activated abilities the ability would still go on cooldown.
[*]Fixed an issue with the ranked map rotation where the wrong versions of Tundra Lake and Lost City were being used.
[*]The effects of the spell Warchief Inauguration can no properly be dispelled.
[*]Fixed an issue the prevented the spell Glimpse of Death from being deployed from Rune Dock.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Prismatic Sigil was giving the melee Frost Attack, Fire Attack, and Magical Attack instead of the range specific versions.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability Dragon Form was not giving the ability Flamestrike when the champion is transformed.
[*]Fixed an issue with the relic Long Fuse Bomb that was causing it not to work.
[/LIST]
[B]Changes[/B]

notes.title: Spirits Beyond Expansion Released!
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

Spirits Beyond is here, and with it comes new runes, a campaign, balance changes, and more!  Now you can see everything that was brought up in the [URL=https://youtu.be/0KyCJeoyys0]Preview Video[/URL] as you play.

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/PoxSPBanner.jpg[/IMG]

[B]General[/B]
[LIST]
[*]51 New runes have been added to Pox Nora. Three of these new runes are Limited Edition.
[*]The League Rewards have been updated to award Spirits Beyond runes.
[*]The all new challenging Hand of Death campaign has been added to Pox Nora, and is available for purchase on the Marketplace.  Completing this brand new campaign on Legendary difficulty will award the Glimpse of Death limited edition rune!
[*]Spirits Beyond Pack has been added to the Marketplace. This pack comes with: 6 common, 3 uncommon, and 1 rare rune. Each rare slot has a 10% chance of becoming an exotic. Each pack comes with 1 FREE Platinum Token..
[*]Spirits Beyond has been added to the Marketplace. This box comes with 10 Spirits Beyond packs. Get 9 packs and the 10th is FREE. The first pack is guaranteed to contain an Exotic and 500 FREE Shards.
[*]Spirits Beyond Megabox has been added to the Marketplace for a limited time. This mega box comes with three Spirits Beyond boxes, one of 2 LEs (Valdaci Emerald or Valdaci Shield) and an additional 5 FREE Platinum tokens.
[*]The rewards for Heroic Achievements no longer count against the daily gold limit.
[*]Made some more improvements on the back end to the Heroic Achievement system.
[*]The Rune Forge limit on crafting Exotic and Legendary runes has been increased to 20 per week from 6 per week.
[*]Now available, an all new [URL=https://www.poxnora.com/info/story.do?i=36]Spirits Beyond Story Chapter.[/URL]
[*]The Visions of Amareth expansion has been added to the Rune Forge.
[*]Due to player feedback we have given the Mountain Slag champion new art.  The old art has been repurposed into a new Armored Fesh for Spirits Beyond.
[*]Website is now fully using the new League icons.
[*]Website rankings will now include all non-Standard Leagues.
[*]Range champions have been adjusted to be more balanced in relation to melee.
[/LIST]
[B]Maps & Map Rotation[/B]
As part of this expansion some maps have had their Font and Shrine locations altered or new versions of existing maps have been added with new placements.  All the maps listed comprise the new ranked map rotation.

[B]New Map Versions[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Axillium II
[*]Forsaken Wastes II
[*]Forsaken Wastes III
[*]Shores of Maljara II
[/LIST]
[B]Updated Map Layout[/B]
[LIST]
[*]K'thir Hill
[/LIST]
[B]New Ranked Map Rotation[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Dark Marsh
[*]Ironfist Mountains
[*]K'thir Forest
[*]Lava Plains
[*]Lost City
[*]Ruins of Valdac
[*]Tundra Lake
[*]K'thir Hill
[*]Axillium II
[*]Forsaken Wastes II
[*]Forsaken Wastes III
[*]Shores of Maljara II
[/LIST]
[B]Game Mechanic Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Faction Bonus for having a full faction K'thir Forest has now been changed to +1 Speed not +1 Speed and +1 AP.
[*]The Diseased condition no longer causes Inhibited
[*]The Scoured condition no longer causes -1 Defense
[*]The Poisoned condition no longer causes -1 Defense and -1 Damage
[*]Relics can now be Eviscerated
[/LIST]
[B]Visions of Amareth Final Days Event[/B]
The [URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/expansion-28-preview-3-and-voa-final-days-event.22100/]Visions of Amareth Final Days Event[/URL] has concluded.  Packs have been awarded to players based on fulfilling the reward criteria of 1 Visions of Amareth pack for every 10 Ranked matches played lasting 10 minutes or longer. To redeem the packs once they have been rewarded, you will need to go to the Marketplace and click on the link that says Entitlements at the top of the screen.

The winner of Grand Prize for the Visions of Amareth Final Days Event can be found on full [URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/spirits-beyond-patch-notes.22274/][B]Patch Notes.[/B][/URL]

[B]Drums of War and Player Ranks[/B]
All players who played a minimum of 50 ranked matches and their primary faction was the Drums of War Winning Faction, [B]Forsaken Wastes[/B], have been awarded 2000 Gold along with 5 Three Day Gold Bonus Tokens.

Drums of War and Player Ranks have been reset. The Players who were the highest contributors to their faction and highest ranked player from each faction have been awarded 15000 Gold. To find out who were the top players be sure to checkout the full [URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/spirits-beyond-patch-notes.22274/][B]Patch Notes.[/B][/URL]

[B]Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed several issues that would result in error messages in a match.
[*]Fixed an issue that was resulting in enemy champions being deployed at the Player's Shrine on the Wrath Walkthrough Campaigns.
[*]Fixed an issue where the condition from the spell Escape Magic couldn't be dispelled.
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing the spell Mirrorhold to instantly destroy champions with the Titan ability.

notes.title: Spirits Beyond Expansion Released!
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

Spirits Beyond is here, and with it comes new runes, a campaign, balance changes, and more!  Now you can see everything that was brought up in the [URL=https://youtu.be/0KyCJeoyys0]Preview Video[/URL] as you play.

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/PoxSPBanner.jpg[/IMG]

[B]General[/B]
[LIST]
[*]51 New runes have been added to Pox Nora. Three of these new runes are Limited Edition.
[*]The League Rewards have been updated to award Spirits Beyond runes.
[*]The all new challenging Hand of Death campaign has been added to Pox Nora, and is available for purchase on the Marketplace.  Completing this brand new campaign on Legendary difficulty will award the Glimpse of Death limited edition rune!
[*]Spirits Beyond Pack has been added to the Marketplace. This pack comes with: 6 common, 3 uncommon, and 1 rare rune. Each rare slot has a 10% chance of becoming an exotic. Each pack comes with 1 FREE Platinum Token..
[*]Spirits Beyond has been added to the Marketplace. This box comes with 10 Spirits Beyond packs. Get 9 packs and the 10th is FREE. The first pack is guaranteed to contain an Exotic and 500 FREE Shards.
[*]Spirits Beyond Megabox has been added to the Marketplace for a limited time. This mega box comes with three Spirits Beyond boxes, one of 2 LEs (Valdaci Emerald or Valdaci Shield) and an additional 5 FREE Platinum tokens.
[*]The rewards for Heroic Achievements no longer count against the daily gold limit.
[*]Made some more improvements on the back end to the Heroic Achievement system.
[*]The Rune Forge limit on crafting Exotic and Legendary runes has been increased to 20 per week from 6 per week.
[*]Now available, an all new [URL=https://www.poxnora.com/info/story.do?i=36]Spirits Beyond Story Chapter.[/URL]
[*]The Visions of Amareth expansion has been added to the Rune Forge.
[*]Due to player feedback we have given the Mountain Slag champion new art.  The old art has been repurposed into a new Armored Fesh for Spirits Beyond.
[*]Website is now fully using the new League icons.
[*]Website rankings will now include all non-Standard Leagues.
[*]Range champions have been adjusted to be more balanced in relation to melee.
[/LIST]
[B]Maps & Map Rotation[/B]
As part of this expansion some maps have had their Font and Shrine locations altered or new versions of existing maps have been added with new placements.  All the maps listed comprise the new ranked map rotation.

[*]Lava Plains
[*]Lost City
[*]Ruins of Valdac
[*]Tundra Lake
[*]K'thir Hill
[*]Axillium II
[*]Forsaken Wastes II
[*]Forsaken Wastes III
[*]Shores of Maljara II
[/LIST]
[B]Game Mechanic Changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Faction Bonus for having a full faction K'thir Forest has now been changed to +1 Speed not +1 Speed and +1 AP.
[*]The Diseased condition no longer causes Inhibited
[*]The Scoured condition no longer causes -1 Defense
[*]The Poisoned condition no longer causes -1 Defense and -1 Damage
[*]Relics can now be Eviscerated
[/LIST]

The [URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/expansion-28-preview-3-and-voa-final-days-event.22100/]Visions of Amareth Final Days Event[/URL] has concluded. notes.title: Expansion 28 Final Preview
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

The release date for the Spirits Beyond expansion is quickly approaching, but we have one final preview to tide all of you over until Expansion 28 is released on March 30th. Normally this is when we reveal more details about specific runes, but since a lot of what would have been shown was revealed in the Flavor Text Contests and the Preview Video we will give all of you something for speculation.

Last week we released the preview video that goes over everything you can look forward to in Spirits Beyond.  If you missed the announcement or are looking to dig up every bit of information about Expansion 28 before it is release then this is a must watch.

https://youtu.be/0KyCJeoyys0

The Shard Pack, Deluxe Shard Pack, and Crazy Token Pack will be available on the [URL=https://www.poxnora.com/store/index.do]Pox Nora Marketplace[/URL] for only a little while longer.  If you need to quickly level up a champion or Forge some Exotic or Legendary runes for when Expansion 28 is released make sure to jump on this offer before March 30th.

notes.title: Expansion 28 Preview 3 and VoA Final Days Event!
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

We are happy to reveal it's official name for Pox Nora's 28th Expansion, Spirits Beyond. As we get closer to the release of Spirits Beyond more will be revealed about what this the name of the expansion is eluding to in regards to lore. This will give all of you some time to speculate as to what that may be.

With today's preview we have more More great things for all of you including an all new event! But , before we get into any of that we need to address the previous contest and event.

[B]Shard Reward Event[/B]
The Shard Reward event has come to an end. All shard rewards have been deposited into the accounts of all qualifying players. For details about the amount of shards see the [URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/shard-reward-event.21899/]Official Announcement[/URL].

[B]Flavor Text Contest 2[/B]
The [URL=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/expansion-28-preview-2-contest-packs-and-more.22013/]Spirits Beyond Flavor Text contest 2[/URL] has concluded. Congratulations to EmperorSauron and Goyo for submitting the flavor text we liked the most for Goblin King and Boundless Enthusiasm. The Shard prize has been deposited into their accounts.

[B]Goblin King[/B]
Champion
Faction: Underdepths
Flavor Text: "Bring me his head! And his leg! And his eyes! I'm in a bad mood today." - Tolgra, Goblin King
By: EmperorSauron

[B]Boundless Enthusiasm[/B]
Spell
Faction: Underdepths
Flavor Text: [I]"I will punch him! Then I will punch him again! And I will kick him in the floor!"[/I] Goblin children playing
By: Goyo

Congratulations again to both EmperorSauron and Goyo!

[B]Visions of Amareth Final Days Event[/B]
The Visions of Amareth expansion is coming to a close and to give it one final send-off we are giving all of you a chance to earn Expansion 27 packs! Starting right now, March 11th, and lasting until 5PM PST March 29th you can earn 1 Visions of Amareth pack for every 10 Ranked matches played. Matches must last a minimum of 10 minutes to count towards this event. For this event you can earn a maximum of 5 packs, but that isn't all!

Grand Prize
At the end of this event we will have a drawing from all the players who received all 5 packs, and one lucky player will get 1 of every Visions of Amareth rune including the Legendary runes in addition to the 5 packs!

You have 20 days to play 50 matches lasting over 10 minutes before the event ends March 29th 5PM PST (8PM EST, March 30th 12AM UTC) Rewards will be given out at the conclusion of this event. To redeem the packs once they have bee rewarded you will need to go to the Marketplace and click on the link that says Entitlements at the top of the screen.

[B]Preview[/B]
Some of you mentioned about too much information spoiling the surprise of new runes. This week we are going old school. Gaze upon this illustration and ponder what these runes will be. They may not actually be what you think they are, and not belong to the faction you would normally assume.

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/Expansion28Preview 3.jpg[/IMG]

[B]Shard & Token Sale[/B]
The Shard and Token pack sale is still going on and will last until Spirits Beyond is released (release date unannounced). Full details about the Shard Pack, Deluxe Shard Pack, or the Crazy Token Pack are on the [URL=https://www.poxnora.com/store/index.do]Pox Nora Marketplace[/URL].

[B]Weekend Tournament[/B]
This weekend's tournament is now available. It is a standard 4 person tournament, using Ranked Maps, with a total turn time limit per player per match of 30 minutes. This tournament will be available from March 11th through March 13th.

Rewards:
[LIST]
[*]1st place: Myx Coordinator and 1 Gold Champion Point Token.
[*]2nd place: Salaman Hunter and 1 Silver Champion Point Token.
[/LIST]
Discussion: [URL]http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/discussion-expansion-28-preview-3-and-voa-final-days-event.22101/[/URL]

notes.notes:

It's that time between expansions where it is quiet, almost too quiet. Well that silence ends now! You can start getting excited because this is the first preview for Pox Nora's 28th expansion.

[IMG]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/Expansion28Preview%201.jpg[/IMG]

This preview is more than just showing you the art we are actually going to show you what the runes will do, and give you the community a chance to contribute with an all new contest!

[B]Flavor Text Contest[/B]
For this Flavor Text contest, players who want to participate can submit as many Flavor Text for the two runes as they want. Flavor Text submitted to this contest can not exceed 250 characters (including spaces) and can not conflict with any current Pox Nora Lore. We are providing the names of the runes featured in the illustration, a description of the illustration, and the description of what the runes do.

Players have until March 2nd 10AM PST (1PM EST, 6 PM UTC) to post their flavor text in the [url=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/expansion-28-flavor-text-contest.21931/]submission thread[/URL] at which point the thread will be locked. Make sure to state which rune the flavor text submission is for in your post. One submission for each rune featured will be chosen by us as the winner and the results will be announced March 4th.

Flavor Text Contest Submission Thread: [URL]http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/expansion-28-flavor-text-contest.21931/[/URL]

Rewards
The player or players who submit the two winning Flavor Texts will be awarded 1000 Gold.

Illustration Description
A merchant caravan of Skeezick and Draksar seek shelter behind a large rock formation in the desert. The wind is thick with sand and it is still hitting the people. Sitting behind them just out of reach of the winds is a bulky barbarian, stroking a small cute looking kitten which he holds to his chest.

Eroding Winds
Spell
Faction: Ironfist Stronghold
Description: For 4 turns, at the start of the opponent's turn, enemy units in a shrine or font deployment zone are Eviscerated for 4 turns. If the unit is a champion, it is also knocked back 2 spaces away from your shrine or avatar.

Wounded Kitten
Equipment
Faction: Shattered Peaks
Description: After 6 turns, this equipment is destroyed, the equipped champ takes 10 Physical damage and becomes Eviscerated for 3 turns and a Young Mountain Lion is summoned to the closest available space under the control of this equipment's owner.

Disclaimer: All Pox Nora content including but not limited to Characters, Story Plots, Places, Factions, and Mechanics are the property of Desert Owl Games. The winning Flavor Text or Texts may be edited by Desert Owl Games for consistency with Pox Nora cannon and contestants forfeit their rights of ownership to the submitted text. Both Wounded Kitten and Eroding Winds are still subject to change.

The shards are earned in 200 at a time for every 10 Ranked matches played or every 10 Single Player match wins. Matches must last a minimum of 10 minutes to count towards this event. The maximum total shards that can be earned during this event is 1000. Rewards will be given out at the conclusion of this event. notes.title: Companionship Gala
notes.notes:
Platonic love is a strong bond between friends, companions, and comrades. It is what drives the factions and races of Poxanthuru to work together and build coalitions for protecting their kin from those who would do them harm.

One particular relationship stands above all others in this land of chaos and turmoil. The bond between one Huntress and her faithful pet boar is everlasting and can weather any force of darkness.

[img]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/barbarianhuntress_vdaysmall.jpg[/img]

From February 10th to February 24th the True Love campaign will be available for free in the Pox Nora Story Campaigns. Help Ayla the Huntress rescue Thor the Tempest Boar from Xulos's insidious experiment. For those who are up for the challenge, beating the True Love campaign on the Legendary Difficulty will award the Limited Edition Ayla the Huntress rune.

For this season, extend a greeting to your fellow Pox Nora player. Work together with for a common goal by grouping up and playing 2v2 matches to get those remaining Team League rewards.

Have Fun!

notes.title: Pox Nora Patch: January 28th, 2016
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

A new patch is now available, which includes bug fixes and design changes. 

[b]Announcement[/b]
For one day, February 2nd, the Boon’s Eve campaign will be available on the Pox Nora [url=https://www.poxnora.com/store/index.do]Marketplace.[/url] This is your chance to get the Limited Edition Blood Owl rune if you missed it for during the Boon's Eve event period.

This one day re-release of the Boon's Eve campaign is coinciding with the [i]All hail our terrible and mighty master Liquin_3rd Day[/i], which is an event created by the community to praise the elusive Pox Nora artist Liquin_3rd.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed several instances were errors would occur when specific game mechanics would interact with each other
    [*]Fixed an issue where Domain: Dead Magic Zone was stacking +2 DMG and +1 DEF for every instance Dead Magic Zone was applied to a single location.
    [*]Poisonburst is no longer incorrectly usable while Incorporeal
    [*]Preparation's stat buffs are now properly removed if the ability is lost
    [*]Stealthed relics should no longer persist for the opponents after destruction
[/list]
For a full list of the balance changes check out the [url=http://forums.poxnora.com/index.php?threads/patch-notes-january-28th-2016.21469/]Official Patch Notes.[/url]

See you on the Battlefield!

notes.title: Visions of Amareth Midterm is here!
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone,

The Visions of Amareth Midterm is here, and with it comes eight new Legendary runes, one Limited Edition rune, a new story, and more!

[img]https://d2wyctv03a17c5.cloudfront.net/VoAMid1.jpg[/img]

[b]Visions of Amareth Midterm Short Story Contest Results[/b]
In December we launched a contest giving players a chance for their short story to become part of Pox Nora Lore. The community narrowed down the entries to 3 finalists. All the entries were exceptional, resulting in this being extremely close decision, but after much deliberation Bellagion's entry A Field Report was determined to be the winner.
